## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Oct 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kiko Jayogue_, Oct 9, 2026, 1/5: "I downloaded Evernote because of simplicity but since they added AI to the app it always have bugs! Can't open it in desktop and it's slow now. Pleasse don't try too much to join the bandwagon you're sacrificing the main purpose of your app 'a note pad' just to join the AI craze."
            2. _Olga Shinalskaja_, Oct 6, 2026, 1/5: "Ads. They are so desperate for us to pay. Maybe they should invest that energy into making a good app instead. This one is buggy and has been as far back as I remember."
            3. _Jimmy Willis_, Oct 6, 2026, 1/5: "I installed this app a while ago for the ad free notes. then it would give us pop-up messages to promote themselves to upgrade and pay. I would just select no and close out of it. no big deal. but now there are ads that don't let you even use the app until they're done and you can't close out of them right away. This app is now unusable. I have deleted all my notes and uninstalled."
